config.physim.port.description: TCP port the extension listens on for the PhySim Lua client.
config.physim.autoOpenOnSimulate.descrip: Auto-open the panel when LifeBoatAPI Simulate (F6) starts.
config.physim.panel.openLocation.descrip: Where to place the Physics Sensor panel when it opens.
config.physim.panel.openLocation.enumDes: Open the panel beside the active editor in the current window (default).
Open the panel in a new floating window (requires VSCode 1.85+).
config.physim.autoInjectLibraryPath.desc: Automatically add the bundled lua/ folder to lifeboatapi.stormworks.libs.libraryPaths for LifeBoatAPI workspaces.
config.physim.monitors.openInNewWindow.m:
Show the microcontroller's monitors in a separate window instead of below the 3D view. The window opens with the first monitor of each simulator session; closing it puts the monitors back into the panel until the next **F6**. `PhySim: Open Monitors in New Window` opens it on demand.

Only applies when PhySim draws the monitors (always on macOS, on Windows with `physim.monitors.useBuiltInOnWindows`). Moving it into its own window needs VSCode 1.85+; older versions open it as a tab.
config.physim.monitors.useBuiltInOnWindo:
**Experimental (Windows only).** Render the microcontroller's monitors inside the PhySim panel instead of launching LifeBoatAPI's `STORMWORKS_Simulator.exe`.

PhySim's monitor view is its own implementation, with drawing rules fitted to in-game screenshots. It does not reproduce `screen.drawMap` terrain (filled with sea colour instead), alt touch (primary touch only), or the exe's input/output panels — drive the channels from the PhySim panel instead. Takes effect on the next **F6**.

On macOS the built-in monitors are always used and this setting is ignored.
